steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8095/ in the browser. If you are not already signed in, sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} — type that password text exactly as given into the password field (the environment fills in the real value when typed; do not guess or alter it). After signing in, report the username shown as signed in and the page you land on.

02-open: Navigate to the repository bench/bench-repo on this Gitea instance (http://127.0.0.1:8095/bench/bench-repo) and open its Issues list (open issues tab). Report the titles of all OPEN issues whose title starts with 'Seed:', exactly as displayed, one per line. Do not modify anything.

03-create: In the repository bench/bench-repo on this Gitea instance, create a NEW issue with title exactly: {{runid}} Bench Issue — and in the description markdown text area write a description that includes the text {{runid}} (for example: 'Bench issue created for run {{runid}}'). Submit the issue. Then report the new issue's title, its displayed issue number (Gitea shows it as #<number>), and the description text as shown on the issue page.

04-set: On the Gitea issue page {{03-create.url}} (titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue'), use the sidebar pickers to: (1) set the issue's labels to EXACTLY 'bug' and 'priority-high' — if any other label is applied, remove it so only those two remain; (2) assign the issue to the user 'bench-assignee'; (3) set the issue's milestone to 'Bench Milestone'. Each choice only counts once the app has applied it and it is visibly shown on the issue page (not merely ticked in the open menu). When done, report exactly which labels are displayed on the issue, the assignee shown, and the milestone shown.
